patches.name: Boost Shopee Live latency and quality
patches.description: Applies smooth fast-connect live optimizations (IPv4-only DNS, hardware decoding, decoder pre-creation, smooth URL switching, zero P2P uploads), adds a stream resolution preset picker (Auto/Lowest/Fast/Balanced/Highest), and stops live telemetry heartbeats and hidden screenshot uploads.

options.title: Live stream resolution preset
options.description: Starting resolution tier for Shopee Live. Auto keeps adaptive bitrate (recommended on mobile data or weak Wi-Fi). Other presets start at that tier.

options.title: Lock selected resolution
options.description: Strips all other tiers so the player can never switch. Removes ABR fallback, so it stutters if your network dips below the tier's bitrate (ignored when Auto is selected).

options.title: Enable fast-connect network boost
options.description: IPv4-only live DNS, connection reuse, smooth URL switching, and decoder pre-creation for faster stream start. Does not shrink buffers.

options.title: Aggressive low-delay mode (Experimental)
options.description: Smaller playback buffers, MediaCodec low-delay decoding, FDK-AAC, and frame-get optimizations. Lowers delay on strong, stable Wi-Fi but can cause stutter on mobile data or some devices.

options.title: Disable Live P2P peer uploading
options.description: Prevents WebRTC/STUN peer-to-peer stream sharing during Live sessions to avoid upload bandwidth drain and peer stall latency.

options.title: Disable Live telemetry & snapshot uploads
options.description: Disables continuous live QoS/heartbeat reporters, CPU/thermal polling threads, and hidden playback screenshot sampling/uploads.

patches.name: Disable Live and Video auto-preloading
patches.description: Disables background Shopee Video download, floating Live video, and Check-In widget components and skips eager Live/Video startup preloading and auto-landing prefetchers.

patches.name: Disable ShopeeTracker event collection
patches.description: Short-circuits ShopeeTracker event logging, MMAP buffer usage, scheduled uploads, and background flush calls while keeping ShopeeTrackerContentProvider intact for SESSION_ID reads.

patches.name: Disable ad and telemetry SDK components
patches.description: Disables third-party and first-party telemetry/APM components, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/DataTransport registrars, and telemetry manifest flags in AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Disable background boot and prefetch receivers
patches.description: Disables manifest receivers triggered on device boot or package replacement so Shopee stays dormant until launched.

patches.name: Disable cold-start APM and profiler valves
patches.description: Skips non-critical cold-start APM, Firebase Analytics, logging pipeline valves, and Luban/StackLens background sampling to cut startup latency, CPU usage, and battery drain.

patches.name: Hide Shopee Video and Live
patches.description: Removes the Shopee Live & Video homepage section before view inflation, disables homepage video autoplay/refresh jobs, and optionally hides the Live & Video bottom navigation tab.

options.title: Hide homepage Shopee Live & Video cards
options.description: Omits the Shopee Live & Video section on the home feed and disables autoplay and background ad-refresh jobs.

options.title: Hide Live & Video bottom navigation tab
options.description: Filters the Live & Video tab out of the bottom bar and disables red-dot/icon animations.

patches.name: Optimize item and network loading
patches.description: Accelerates product, PDP, and feed loading by enabling Cronet Zstd/QUIC prewarming and multi-IP failover, native PDP prefetching, multi-threaded feed decode, instant image rendering, and removing per-request network and image telemetry overhead.

options.title: Enable Cronet Zstd, prewarm, and telemetry removal
options.description: Forces Cronet Zstd compression, URL prewarming, alternative connection setup, multi-address failover, and strips per-request Cronet/HttpDNS telemetry reporters.

options.title: Enable native PDP & feed performance toggles
options.description: Enables native product-detail prefetching, multi-threaded feed decode, image preloading, lazy tab bar, ANR fixes, and disables home GIF decoding and feed AptLog telemetry.

options.title: Instant product image rendering
options.description: Eliminates Glide image fade-in animation delays and skips per-image performance telemetry callbacks and SDNS metrics uploads.

patches.name: Patch smoke test
patches.description: Adds a harmless manifest metadata marker so you can test whether a re-signed Shopee APK boots and logs in without triggering F13 integrity errors.

patches.name: Stop background telemetry and sync workers
patches.description: Short-circuits background WorkManager telemetry uploaders so Shopee stays dormant in the background without triggering WorkManager retry loops.

options.title: Disable background AptLog re-upload worker
options.description: Completes AptLogReuploadWorker immediately with Result.success() without waking the network.

options.title: Disable background DataPoint sync worker (Experimental)
options.description: Skips background HFSyncInfo/LFSyncInfo/MFSyncInfo/PermissionStatusSyncInfo reporting inside DataPointService. Kept off by default to avoid potential F13 risk on sensitive accounts.

options.title: Disable background React Native OTA bundle sync
options.description: Stops BundleSyncService from downloading React Native OTA updates in the background while the app is closed.

patches.name: Strip unused CPU architectures
patches.description: Removes native libraries for unused CPU architectures from universal APKs to reduce app size and startup scan overhead.

options.title: CPU architecture to keep
options.description: Native library ABI directory to keep. No libraries are deleted if this ABI is absent.

patches.name: Trim invasive and battery-draining permissions
patches.description: Removes non-essential privacy, advertising, and background wake permissions (background location, AD_ID, call log, contacts, calendar, exact alarms, boot completed, OEM badges) while keeping camera, foreground location, notifications, and biometric auth intact.
